summary: The permanent Physics Lab authors cabinet-a and the collidable ledge with a deterministic physical interpenetration. The axis-aligned ledge spans x=[2.50,4.70], y=[0,0.65], z=[1.90,3.70] meters; the 180-degree filing-cabinet shell spans x=[4.61,5.09], y=[0,1.32], z=[3.59,4.21]. Their overlap is therefore 0.09 m by 0.11 m in plan through the ledge's full 0.65 m height. The F2 adapter realizes every ObjectGenome component as anchored CanCollide=true, so this is source-authored collidable geometry overlap rather than envelope-only metadata noise.

The same main recipe places cabinet-a at {4.85,0.66,3.90} with yaw 180 degrees. The filing-cabinet shell is centered locally with dimensionsM={0.48,1.32,0.62}, so 180-degree yaw leaves its axis-aligned extents x=[4.61,5.09], y=[0,1.32], z=[3.59,4.21].
Those extents intersect by 0.09 m on x and 0.11 m on z while sharing y=[0,0.65], a deterministic 90 mm x 110 mm collidable penetration through the complete ledge height.

PhysicsLabRealizer realizes every ObjectGenome component as an anchored Part with CanCollide=true, CanQuery=true, and CanTouch=true; cabinet shell overlap is therefore present in the disposable F2 physical representation.

The accepted source-only geometry/property lineage checks finite placement, shell alignment, door aperture fit, ObjectGenome grounding, stair continuity, ramp entry/incline, and spawn placement, but does not assert inter-entity primitive/ObjectGenome separation. Repository PR/issue search found no existing cabinet/ledge overlap repair lane.

Retained geometry PR #423 does not move the ledge or cabinet, and retained office-chair PR #347 does not change filing-cabinet dimensions, so the overlap remains relevant to the queued geometry stack rather than being repaired by current retained successors.
No Roblox Studio, viewport, dynamic contact, or performance evidence is claimed; this finding is derived from deterministic authored meter geometry and the existing F2 realization contract.
